boundary: Actual common data/model/source observed; twelve full-horizon recipe identities derived without training. Revised data and new v3 run IDs differ; model/source/runtime/hyperparameters do not. Old protocols remain unchanged and ineligible for new data. Derived subset values match the revised parents but no scientific consumer is deployed by this receipt.

original_analysis.historical_bridge: Compare corrected and historical rankings/deltas descriptively as an execution-path sensitivity analysis; do not pool their checkpoints into one causal estimate.
original_analysis.primary_estimand: At the final checkpoint, average nDCG@10 over the four predeclared learning rates within optimizer for each task, then contrast Muon-AdamW, NorMuon-AdamW, and NorMuon-Muon across the 14 paired tasks.
original_analysis.primary_support_rule: An optimizer-family advantage is supported only when its simultaneous 95% interval versus AdamW lies wholly above zero and all four rates completed. An interval wholly below zero supports a disadvantage; otherwise report inconclusive.
original_analysis.primary_uncertainty: 50,000 paired task bootstraps with seed 20260903; simultaneous max-T 95% intervals over the three optimizer contrasts.
original_analysis.secondary_estimand: Compare the validation-selected recipe per optimizer on final-checkpoint mean nDCG@10 using the same paired max-T procedure; label this secondary.
original_analysis.stability: Report completion, non-finite values, gradient norms, peak memory, accepted wall time, checkpoint bytes, and optimizer-state bytes for every run.
original_analysis.training_dynamics: Report every optimizer-rate-task checkpoint, optimizer-level stage means, and trapezoidal area over normalized progress. Dynamics are descriptive unless an interval procedure is explicitly added without changing the primary rule.
original_analysis.weight_space: At all five checkpoints, report update norm, update-to-weight ratio, singular-value effective/stable rank, top-subspace overlap with AdamW, and representation/retrieval bridges. These mechanism analyses are secondary and cannot substitute for the primary retrieval contrast.

original_evaluation.benchmark: the same 14 pinned decontaminated BEIR tasks used by the historical Dense study
original_evaluation.retrieval: exact full-corpus scoring with the existing pinned task revisions and evaluator contract

validation_selection.rule: Within each optimizer, choose the final-checkpoint learning rate with minimum mean contrastive loss across all 4096 rows; ties choose the lower learning rate. BEIR is not an input.

original_training.completion_rule: A run is complete only if all five deeply audited checkpoints, the final model, accepted timing ledger, and independently_padded execution receipt agree.
original_training.failure_rule: Never drop or replace a failed high-rate run. Retry only from a deeply valid checkpoint. Persistent numerical failure is an optimizer-stability result and prevents a complete-grid superiority claim.
original_training.input_execution: SentenceTransformers can_flatten_inputs=false, independently padded within each of the eight explicit text columns
